checks.title: Bordered container inside bordered container
checks.description: A visible border (any side width >= 1px with non-transparent color, or an outline) on an element whose nearest bordered ancestor within the same view also has one.
procedure: Collect elements whose computed border-*-width > 0 and border-style != none and border color alpha > 0, or box-shadow with a 0-blur spread ring matching a 1px outline.
For each, walk ancestors up to the app root; if an ancestor in the collection exists, report the pair.
Ignore form controls listed in exceptions.
exceptions: input, textarea, select, checkbox and radio controls
Floating overlays (menu, popover, dialog, toast) that carry a single outline
Table cell grids when the table itself has no outer border

checks.title: Thick left border on non-quote elements
checks.description: border-left-width is at least 2px and is greater than the border-right-width of the same element, on an element that is not a blockquote or code diff gutter.
procedure: For each element compute border-left-width and border-right-width.
Report when left >= 2px and left > right and tag is not blockquote and the element does not carry data-semantic-gutter.
exceptions: blockquote
Diff or code gutters
Elements with data-semantic-gutter set by the product with a documented meaning

checks.title: Translucent tinted destructive button
checks.description: A button or button-like control that looks destructive (danger-colored text, or label matching a destructive verb) has a translucent background (alpha < 0.9) and danger-hued text.
procedure: Select button, [role=button], a.btn.
Mark destructive when text color hue is red (hue 0-20 or 340-360, saturation > 0.35) or the accessible name matches the destructive verb pattern.
Fail when destructive and background-color alpha is between 0.01 and 0.9, or background is transparent with a tinted translucent sibling wrapper.
Also fail when contrast of text against the composited background is below 4.5:1.
exceptions: Menu items (role=menuitem) styled as danger text with icon
Non-interactive error banners (not buttons)

checks.title: Accent color used for focus, selection or input outline
checks.description: Focus, :focus-visible, :focus-within, [aria-selected], .selected, .active and input outline rules must not reference the brand accent color or its tints.
procedure: Parse CSS rules whose selector contains :focus, :focus-visible, :focus-within, [aria-selected, [aria-current, .selected, .active.
Fail if the declarations for outline, box-shadow, border-color or background reference --accent, --accent-hover, --accent-soft, --accent-text or an emerald literal (#10b981 and tints).
Allow semantic danger or warn tokens.
exceptions: Primary action hover or pressed state (.btn-primary:hover)
Brand-colored focus ring for a product that explicitly defines a brand ring in its own tokens (documented exception)

checks.title: Decorative pill tags and status pills
checks.description: Small fully rounded labels (height < 28px, border-radius >= half height) that are not interactive and that repeat on rows, or that carry words such as Saved, New, Active, Live, Beta without a filtering function.
procedure: Find non-interactive elements with border-radius >= height/2, height <= 28px, text length <= 20.
Count per view; raise warning when more than 3 appear or any text matches the decorative pattern.
Mark needs-human when the tag appears in a filterable list (it may be functional).
exceptions: Tags used to filter, group or navigate by category
Count badges on navigation entries

checks.title: Placeholder initials avatar
checks.description: A round element (border-radius >= 50%) whose only content is 1 to 2 letters, or an img whose src is a generated initials or identicon placeholder, with no real image.
procedure: Find elements with border-radius >= 50% and width/height <= 64px.
Fail when textContent trimmed matches ^[A-Za-z]{1,2}$ and there is no child img or svg with non-text content.
Fail when an img src matches ui-avatars, dicebear, identicon, gravatar default or data URIs generated from initials.
exceptions: Real user profile images
Count badges and currency symbols (not identity)

checks.title: Excessive mobile vertical density
checks.description: At a 390px viewport, the stack above the primary content region is too tall or too tight.
procedure: Render at 390x844.
Measure the distance from the top of the viewport to the first primary content element (main list, feed, form).
Warn when more than 3 distinct control rows precede it, when that distance exceeds 45 percent of viewport height, or when vertical gaps between adjacent control rows are below 8px.
Report needs-human for borderline cases.
exceptions: Task screens where the controls are the content (checkout steps, forms)

checks.title: Send and Stop visible together
checks.description: Two controls with opposing functions for the same operation are visible at the same time.
procedure: Within one container find buttons whose accessible names match Send/Submit and Stop/Cancel generation pairs.
Fail when both are visible and enabled.
exceptions: Both actions can genuinely be used at the same time (for example Save and Discard in an editor)

checks.title: Create button adjacent to a selection dropdown
checks.description: A button whose label starts with Create, New or Add is a direct sibling of a select, combobox or dropdown trigger for the same entity type.
procedure: Find select, [role=combobox], [aria-haspopup=listbox] triggers.
Inspect siblings within the same row container; flag buttons matching ^(create|new|add)\b with an entity noun in common with the dropdown label or placeholder.
Report needs-human when the nouns do not match.
exceptions: A primary page-level Create action that is not tied to the dropdown

checks.title: Unnecessary explanatory copy
checks.description: Persistent helper paragraphs that explain familiar controls.
procedure: Find p, small and .help elements of 25 or more characters directly adjacent to form controls, buttons or section headings.
Warn when the count per view exceeds 2 or any starts with phrases such as 'Use this', 'Here you can', 'This is where'.
Always mark needs-human: the check only surfaces candidates.
exceptions: Legal, safety and error messages
Dismissible first-run hints
patterns: ^(use this|here you can|this is where|click (the )?button|welcome to)

checks.title: More than one navigation sidebar
checks.description: Two or more elements with navigation role are laid out as side-by-side vertical columns at the left edge.
procedure: Find nav, aside[aria-label*=nav], [role=navigation] elements with height >= 60 percent of the viewport and width <= 360px.
Fail when two or more are siblings in the same flex or grid row and the second starts where the first ends.
Content panes (filters, inspectors, watchlists) without navigation role do not count.
exceptions: Content panes with navigation-free roles
Mobile drawer open on top of content

checks.title: Accent color overuse
checks.description: Brand accent pixels dominate the view.
procedure: Collect visible elements whose computed color, background-color or border-color is the accent or within a perceptual distance of 12 delta E.
Warn when accent covers more than 2 percent of the viewport area, or when more than 3 distinct elements are accent-filled in one view.
Mark needs-human when data visualisation is present.
exceptions: Data visualisation series
Brand marks, the single primary action, meaningful state indicators

checks.title: Decorative gradients and glow
checks.description: Gradients or glows on UI chrome.
procedure: Search CSS for linear-gradient, radial-gradient, conic-gradient on UI chrome selectors, and box-shadow or filter drop-shadow with blur >= 12px and a non-black color.
Ignore gradients on image, canvas, svg, chart, [data-media] and skeleton shimmer selectors.
exceptions: Scrims over imagery for text legibility
Media content, charts and skeleton loaders
Overlay elevation shadows (black, low alpha)

checks.title: Indentation used for hierarchy
checks.description: Content blocks are progressively shifted right by padding or margin to express depth.
procedure: For lists and tree-like structures compute the left edge of each item content box.
Warn when three or more consecutive items show increasing left edge offsets of at least 12px, or role=tree/treeitem is used for navigation.
exceptions: Marker gutters of bullet or numbered lists
Nested replies when the product requires threaded indentation (document the exception)

checks.title: Redundant card containers
checks.description: Card surfaces wrap a single child that is itself a card or wrap content that needs no container.
procedure: Find elements with a surface background different from their parent (card).
Warn when a card has exactly one element child that is also a card, or when card nesting depth is 3 or more.
exceptions: Dialogs containing a single card-like preview

checks.title: Excessive visible controls
checks.description: Too many always-visible controls in one toolbar or view.
procedure: Count visible interactive elements inside each header or toolbar container.
Warn when a toolbar has more than 7 icon-only buttons, or a view shows more than 20 simultaneously visible controls outside lists and grids.
exceptions: Editors that pair a keyboard-reachable palette with their toolbar
Dense data tables where each row action is revealed on hover

checks.title: Em dash in user-facing copy
checks.description: The em dash character (U+2014) appears in UI strings, markup text, aria-labels, placeholders or demo data.
procedure: Search source text and rendered textContent, title, alt, aria-label and placeholder values for U+2014.
Fail on every occurrence (also report ' -- ' and ' - ' used as prose dashes as warnings).
exceptions: Code comments and documentation outside the shipped UI may be exempt if the project says so

checks.title: Keyboard focus indicator contrast
checks.description: Every focusable element shows a focus indicator with at least 3:1 contrast against the adjacent surface when focused with the keyboard.
procedure: Tab through all focusable elements.
For each focused element compute the indicator color (outline-color, or box-shadow ring) composited over the surface behind it.
Fail when contrast is below 3:1 or when outline-style is none and no ring replaces it.
Warn when ring thickness exceeds 2px (principle 17 weight).
exceptions: Native controls using browser default focus rings

checks.title: Destructive button text contrast
checks.description: Text on destructive buttons reaches at least 4.5:1.
procedure: Find destructive controls using the CHK-003 heuristic.
Composite the background over its backdrop and compute contrast with the text color.

checks.title: Touch target effective hit area on mobile
checks.description: At 390px, every interactive element has an effective hit area of at least 40 by 40 CSS pixels that the browser actually assigns to it, with no overlap with neighbouring controls.
procedure: Render at 390x844 with touch enabled; repeat with a tall viewport (full page) and with any mobile drawer open.

For each visible interactive element (button, link, input, select, summary, role button/tab/checkbox/switch/menuitem/option/link, focusable label) take a square centred on it of size max(width, 40) by max(height, 40).
Sample the square on a 4px grid with elementFromPoint. The effective hit area is the bounding box of the sample points that resolve to the element (or its descendant, or its label).
Fail when the effective width or height is below 38px (2px sampling tolerance). Report the element that owns the missing area when another control overlaps it.
Optionally confirm with real touch taps at the centre and inset corners of the effective area, intercepting clicks in the capture phase so application state is unchanged.
exceptions: Inline text links inside running text
Elements covered by an overlay at their own centre
Visually hidden inputs whose label is tested instead

checks.title: Horizontal overflow
checks.description: The page scrolls horizontally at 375px, 390px or 1440px.
procedure: For each viewport compare document.documentElement.scrollWidth to window.innerWidth.
Fail when scrollWidth exceeds innerWidth.
exceptions: Intentionally scrollable regions inside a container (tables, carousels) that do not widen the page

checks.title: Focus outline removed without replacement
checks.description: Rules that remove the outline (outline: none or outline: 0) on focusable elements must provide a replacement ring in the same rule or via :focus-visible.
procedure: Parse rules with outline: none or outline: 0 whose selector targets button, a, input, textarea, select, [tabindex], [role].
Pass only when the same selector family declares box-shadow, border-color or background change under :focus-visible.
exceptions: Containers focused programmatically (tabindex=-1) that never receive keyboard focus

humanJudgment.question: Does the screen feel calm? Is anything competing for attention that should not?
Is hierarchy readable without borders, using elevation, spacing and type?
Do selection and focus read clearly but quietly (not dominant, not invisible)?
On mobile, does the layout breathe, or does it feel compressed? Would more scrolling help?
Does the layout suit the task and match user expectations for this kind of product?
Are copy and labels natural, concise and free of needless explanation?
Do destructive actions look serious and readable, and differ from neutral ones without relying on color alone?
Does every identity element (avatar, initials, picture) represent real content?
Do all screens feel like one product family (spacing, controls, corners, motion)?
Are semantic colors (movement, error, success) used where meaning requires them and nowhere else?
